talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 22 solo PCPs winding down in Nevada; 5 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Las Vegas 89128, Las Vegas 89121, Henderson 89052) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~3,608 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Nye County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 4 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~54,000 patients across 45 at-risk practices statewide.
